performance.basis: Diesel engines cause downtime, and therefore cable supply from the host platform is preferred

performance.metric: Reliability — Subsea HSP multiphase pump run-life claim (adjacent technology)
performance.basis: The multiphase variant of the HSP has over ten years successful operation as the primary means of production in subsea wells and has demonstrated run lives around three times longer than the industry average for electric submersible pumps

HVAC systems serving spaces where area classification depends on ventilation or where operational aspects require extensive ventilation availability shall have back-up capacity/ adequate standby /redundancy

performance.metric: Reliability — Battery room ventilation on emergency power
performance.basis: The battery rooms shall have 100% duty plus standby explosion proof exhaust fans, with automatic change-over in event of failure of main fan

performance.metric: Reliability — Electro-hydraulic crane versus diesel generator loading
performance.basis: The use of electro-hydraulic cranes is not recommended on installations with diesel generators, as the diesel engine will be sized for the major user: the crane. Therefore, for the majority of the time, the engine will run on a very low utilisation, which causes problems for diesel engines
As printed on the cited page.

performance.basis: Typically at least two units must be running with at least one spare (possible exception for water injection)

performance.metric: Reliability — Two independent starting systems with automatic changeover
performance.basis: Diesel engines with two independent starting systems shall have an automatic changeover device
